name: Stone Hill Town Center
summary: Stone Hill Town Center is Pflugerville's premier shopping destination and the #2 most visited center within a 50-mile radius of Austin. This expansive community center features big-box retailers, diverse dining options, a movie theater, and is complemented by over 1,000 new residential units creating a vibrant mixed-use environment.
demographics: Stone Hill Town Center attracts a diverse mix of families and young professionals from Pflugerville and surrounding Austin suburbs, with a median household income reflecting the area's growing tech-sector workforce. The trade area serves a predominantly millennial and Gen-X demographic with children, drawn to the center's combination of big-box retail, family dining, and entertainment options including the movie theater. As the #2 most visited shopping center within a 50-mile radius, it captures both convenience-driven local shoppers and destination visitors seeking a comprehensive retail and entertainment experience in the rapidly expanding northern Austin market.
description: Stone Hill Town Center stands as the premier shopping destination in Pflugerville, Texas, earning recognition as the #2 most visited shopping center within a 50-mile radius and ranking among the top 5 largest shopping centers in the Austin area. This dynamic community center offers an endless selection of retail stores, entertainment venues, dining establishments, and essential services, anchored by big-box retailers and featuring a popular movie theater. The center's straightforward strip mall design maximizes accessibility and convenience for shoppers throughout the greater Austin metropolitan area. Beyond its retail offerings, Stone Hill Town Center is evolving into a complete lifestyle destination with the addition of 1,050 multifamily residential units, including 409 units in Phase One delivered by the end of 2023, creating a true live-work-shop environment. Professionally leased and managed by NewQuest Properties, the center continues to serve as a cornerstone of the Pflugerville community, offering both established national retailers and local businesses a prime location along Limestone Commercial Drive.
